# Networks

Network creation changes daemon state. Use an authorized disposable daemon for
experiments; the context manager removes the created network on exit.

```python
from pywhales import DockerClient
from pywhales.components.network.models import NetworkIPAMPool

client = DockerClient()
with client.network.create(
    "example",
    internal=True,
    enable_ipv6=True,
    ipam_pools=[
        NetworkIPAMPool(subnet="192.0.2.0/24", gateway="192.0.2.1"),
        NetworkIPAMPool(subnet="2001:db8::/64", gateway="2001:db8::1"),
    ],
) as network:
    print(network.id)
```

`None` omits boolean flags; explicit `False` emits `--internal=false` or
`--ipv6=false`. Pool options follow input order in argv, but inspect order is
not guaranteed. Pool fields are associated by address containment, not flag
adjacency; demonstrable cross-pool reassociation and duplicate auxiliary names
are rejected. A supplied pool sequence, even empty, cannot be combined with
singular `subnet` or `gateway`. Mapping keys cannot be empty or contain `=`;
values may contain `=`. Pool subnet, gateway and range values cannot contain CSV
delimiters or quotes. Legacy singular subnet and gateway values are forwarded
unchanged. Invalid addresses, driver options and Docker conflicts remain
CLI/daemon errors; no compatibility probe or fallback is attempted.

The reference behavior is [Docker CLI v28.0.0 network create](https://github.com/docker/cli/blob/f9ced58158d5e0b358052432244b483774a1983d/cli/command/network/create.go#L144-L265)
and its [mapping parser](https://github.com/docker/cli/blob/f9ced58158d5e0b358052432244b483774a1983d/opts/opts.go#L158-L170).
This reference is not a supported-version qualification. Live effective
configuration has not been verified.
